# dsh-media-tools
Two independent DSH/Cordis plugins, agent skills, a CLI and a stdio MCP server, with included on-dem
and Omni listening and native temporal video backends. The old Local AI v2 application does not need
listening and native temporal video backends. The old Local AI v2 application does not need to run.
| Plugin | Selectable tools |

| Audio | `analyze_audio`, `edit_audio`, `convert_audio`, `transcribe_audio`, `listen_audio` |
| Vid
eo | `probe_video`, `convert_video`, `analyze_video` |
Audio analysis returns inline waveform/FFT/spectrogram and waterfall plots, measured digital levels,
and numerical spectrum data. Editing creates a new WAV. Conversion supports audio extraction plus W
AV/FLAC/MP3/M4A/OGG and MP4/WebM/GIF. CPU Whisper supplies timestamped speech. Omni supplies fallibl
e sound descriptions. Native video preserves temporal frames, aligned audio and engine evidence.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
This installs both skills into `~/.agents/skills`, copies the runtime into a versioned directory und
er `~/.local/share/dsh-media-tools`, and configures `~/.config/dsh-media/config.json`. It uses V2 **
once as an import source**, copies native executables into its own cache, and reuses the model store
. The old V2 application and inference companion can stay stopped. On Linux, an available standalone
Python distribution is also imported into package-owned storage when no `--python` is specified. Mo
ving the plugin checkout does not break the installed skills.
FFmpeg and FFprobe binaries install automatically through pinned npm dependencies. Python 3.12 with
venv/pip and an NVIDIA driver are host prerequisites. Setup installs the CUDA user-space runtime lib
raries. The native executable bundle currently targets Linux x64/CUDA 13; Windows/macOS GPU executio
n is not qualified. CPU tools use the platform FFmpeg dependencies where available.
For a fresh machine with separately selected models, replace `--local-ai` with `--backend-config /pa
th/to/backend-models.json`. Setup downloads and SHA256-verifies this repo's versioned native runtime
asset. Model weights are large and remain separate: Omni plus its projector is about 21 GB; native
video may need considerably more. See standalone backend setup.
For CPU tools only, omit `--include-backends` and `--local-ai`; configure `--whisper-model /path/to/
faster-whisper-model` for speech. Existing unowned or locally edited skills are preserved; upgrades
stop before replacing them. Previous runtime releases remain for rollback. `node src/install.mjs --u
ninstall` removes only owned, unchanged skills and preserves models, config and workspace outputs.
## DSH
Target: DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` and Cordis `~4.0.5`. Package and install from your chosen DSH profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The package inserts `dsh-media-audio` and `dsh-media-video` as independently switchable plugins. The
y use DSH tool registration, attachments, prompt sections and Cordis lifecycle cleanup; no host sour
ce patch is needed. Disabling either cancels its owned work and removes its registrations. It never
deletes generated files or models. Individual inserts are also in `audio.patch.yml` and `video.patch
s generated files or models. Individual inserts are also in `audio.patch.yml` and `video.patch.yml`.
Where installed, DSH's `modelScheduler` service handles GPU admission so managed models can unload b
efore media inference and resume afterward. The workers also hold a package-owned lock and refuse to
collide with an unrelated GPU owner. MCP clients cannot control another application's private sched
uler: unload an unrelated resident model before standalone GPU inference.
Do not register duplicate tool names through both the direct plugins and MCP in one DSH profile. The
installer does not modify a live DSH profile or reload DSH.
## MCP
The installer prints the runtime path. Add this server to your MCP client:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The official MCP SDK server exposes all eight tools and returns plot image blocks, saved files and r
eport JSON. Select tools normally in your client. Audio playback uses returned WAV paths where the c
lient supports it. Allow a long tool timeout for GPU jobs. For Codex, the setup syntax is documented
in official MCP configuration.
## CLI
[代码示例省略，未执行]
CLI/MCP paths are relative to the explicitly authorized workspace. DSH can use the latest single med
ia upload or an attachment ID. Outputs are unique `.dsh-media` directories; originals stay unchanged
. See conversion recipes.
**Model requirement:** `analyze_video` is specifically for models with native temporal video support
and a compatible engine/projector. User deployment examples include Flash 3.8, Flash Next, Qwen 3.6
35B-A3B and Qwen 27B. These are deployment labels, not a tested compatibility matrix. Each model/en
gine/projector combination needs qualification. The bundled native path preserves 6 FPS, 15-second w
indows, 3-second overlap, SVE2 records and M-RoPE traces. It never replaces temporal video with inde
pendent still frames.
Numerical audio segments are at most 120 seconds and 25 million channel-samples. Input size is at mo
st 2 GiB. CPU transcription and conversions/edits are bounded to two hours; conversions default to t
he first 30 seconds. Numerical levels are dBFS, not calibrated SPL. Whisper likelihoods are not corr
ectness percentages. Omni captions can hallucinate; compare descriptions with measured evidence.
## Development and provenance
Run `npm ci && npm test` with the pinned Python requirements; `DSH_MEDIA_PYTHON` selects the interpr
eter. Optional live inference checks are separate from the normal CPU/MCP/Cordis suite. See validati
on, advanced backends, source provenance and third-party notices.
The portable CPU runner enforces path checks, not an OS sandbox. The included Linux GPU backend runs
owned processes with per-job scratch, bounded inputs and cancellation. Native executable assets and
vendored Strata/llama components keep their licenses. Private settings, credentials, chat histories
, recordings and model weights are not checked into this repository.
